rows.text: Bid Launch Request – International A2P SMS Joint Bid - MIC1&MIC2
MIC1 & MIC2 Launch of a Joint Bid for the provision of International A2P SMS service

This public bid is conducted on the basis of a fixed price per SMS, with a guaranteed minimum annual volume of SMS messages . The evaluation shall be based exclusively on the committed volume above the minimum threshold of SMS messages, while maintaining the fixed unit price.
